rv.q: See Sunset Baby at least for the pleasure of hearing the thumping bass and the holy cry of Nina Simone's voice that soundtracks the play.
Sunset Baby is one of those dramas that has appreciated with age, shining with intensity in the twilight of America's postwar order.
...Morriseau’s tender-but-muscular writing...allow us to acknowledge their shortcomings
Morisseau is one of those rare playwrights who never lets an audience down.
Morisseau is, in outlook, a spiritual cousin to Hammett, Chandler, and James M. Cain.
